name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: A one-time code in separate cells, with paste and SMS autofill.

props.name: groupSize
props.description: Cells per group; groups are split by a dash. 0 for one group.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Which characters are allowed. Digits by default.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the cells invalid without one.

props.name: success
props.description: The code checked out: a message under the cells (replaces the hint), or `true` for green cells alone. Ignored while there is an error.

props.name: onResend
props.description: Shows "Didn’t get it?" with a resend under the cells, open after `resendAfter` seconds. Return a promise to show a spinner until the code is sent.

props.name: resendAfter
props.description: Seconds before the code can be sent again, counted from when the field appears and from each resend.

props.name: suggestion
props.description: A code that arrived by text or email, offered in a popover under the cells; choosing it fills them.

props.name: suggestionFrom
props.description: Where the suggested code came from, after it in the popover. Defaults to the `fromMessages` label.
